gloss: to dance; to flutter; to whirl

definitions.explanation: To perform a traditional or ceremonial dance, especially in Japanese performing arts.

definitions.gloss: to flutter; to whirl; to swirl
definitions.explanation: When something light moves through the air in a dancing motion, such as leaves, snow, or petals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{巫女|みこ}→巫女：12408_miko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{神前|しんぜん}→神前：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{舞|ま}っている。
examples.english: A shrine maiden is dancing before the altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{舞|ま}った。
examples.english: She danced beautifully on the Noh stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}な→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧⟦{踊|おど}り→踊り：01347_odori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{舞|ま}った。
examples.english: Local people performed traditional dances at the festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{舞|ま}っている。
examples.english: Cherry blossom petals are fluttering in the wind.
I walked while snow swirled and scattered around me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{舞|ま}い⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧、⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{消|き}えていった→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: Fallen leaves swirled up in the wind and disappeared into the sky.

notes:
{舞|ま}う is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). There is no direct transitive pair.

ASPECT (ている):
{舞|ま}っている indicates an ongoing dancing or fluttering motion.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}う - petals flutter
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}う - snow swirls
- ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}う - fallen leaves flutter
- {舞|ま}い⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ - to soar up, to be elated
- {舞|ま}い⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧ - to flutter and scatter

{舞|ま}う VS ⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧:
{舞|ま}う refers to graceful, flowing movements often associated with traditional or ceremonial dances, while ⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧ is the general word for dancing and covers more energetic, modern styles.
